app.title: Genesy Till
app.tagline: Point of sale and cash payouts.

setup.title: Set up this till
setup.hint: Enter the workspace id and the device key shown once in office when the register was created.

login.title: Who is selling?
login.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again later.
login.keyRefused: This device's key is no longer accepted. Set up the till again.
login.expired: Your session ended. Log in again to continue.
login.usersFailed: Couldn't load the till users. Check the connection and reload.
login.noUsers: No till users yet. Ask the office to add one.

sale.title: Sale
sale.estimateHint: Offline: catalog prices incl. VAT. The server's total, rounding and change come with the sale when it syncs.
sale.savedHint: The till is offline. This sale is kept on this device and sent once the connection is back.
sale.noShift: No shift is open on this register. Cash sales need an open shift.
sale.catalogEmpty: This register has no products to sell yet. Ask the office.
sale.catalogFailed: Couldn't load the product list. Check the connection.
sale.catalogStale: Couldn't refresh the product list. Showing the copy on this device.
sale.mismatch: Some prices differ from the current catalog. The office will see this.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.none: No shift is open on this register.
drawer.queued: {count, plural, one {# offline sale} other {# offline sales}} still to sync. Sync before closing the shift.
drawer.loadFailed: Couldn't load the drawer. Check the connection.
drawer.opened: Shift opened. You can start selling.

count.invalid: Each row needs a value (e.g. 5.00) and a whole number of pieces.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.mismatch: This sale was charged at prices that differ from the current catalog. The office will see it.

queue.title: Offline sales
queue.badge: {count, plural, =0 {Offline sales synced} one {# sale to sync} other {# sales to sync}}
queue.emptyHint: Sales rung up without a connection wait here until they are sent.
queue.showOffice: This sale was not booked. Show it to the office before dismissing it.
queue.mismatch: Charged at prices that differ from the current catalog. The office will see it.

errors.crashBody: Sales waiting to sync are still kept on this device. Try again, or go back to the sale screen.

offline.title: Offline. Sales are kept on this device and sent when the connection is back.
offline.waiting: {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} waiting to sync
